notices.method: Global Findex is an indicator database, not one official composite score. GIR stores official indicator estimates and never invents a synthetic overall index.
notices.missing_data: Missing estimates remain missing. GIR does not interpolate survey waves, merge the 2022-labelled delayed observations into 2021, or impute subgroups.
notices.ranking: Rank, percentile and subgroup gaps are GIR analytical fields calculated for one selected official indicator, year and population subgroup.
notices.survey: The 2025 edition is based on nationally representative Gallup World Poll surveys of adults age 15 and older conducted during 2024.
